observations: All four frozen predictors overestimate Q40; Full error is largest.
Q40 has the largest five-window reference variation among six GLN sites.
Q40 is exposed in the initial structure; no 4A direct UBA sidechain contact in 5000 saved frames.
Q40 has intermittent Pro37/terminal Arg72 intrachain contacts; no unique persistent polar lock or monotone last-window contact release was identified.
Coarse-state angular dependence is not exceptional compared with Q41.
Coarse-grid sensitivity is not largest for Q40.
supported_hypothesis: The learned mapping from backbone environment to sidechain state occupation overestimates the diversity of this exposed but relatively concentrated site; temporal changes in occupation make a single-structure estimate of the fixed five-window average harder. Specific molecular causation is unresolved.
causal_limit: No same-weight partner deletion, molecular intervention, independent MD repeat, or new training was performed. Contacts are distance-based observations, not verified hydrogen bonds.
